chunks: From him, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from ʿUmar ibn Udhaynah, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about the two rakʿahs of fajr, and he said: Pray them before fajr, with fajr, and after fajr.

key_terms.رَكْعَتَيِ ٱلْفَجْرِ: the two rakʿahs associated with the fajr prayer
key_terms.صَلِّهِمَا: perform the two units of prayer
key_terms.مَعَ ٱلْفَجْرِ: together with or at the time of fajr

ai.seo_question: When can the two rakʿahs of fajr be prayed according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the time of the two rakʿahs associated with fajr. It indicates latitude in performing them before fajr, alongside fajr, or after fajr, reflecting a jurisprudential ruling concerning devotional prayer timing.
